calls.statement:
SELECT tier, is_current, (valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31') AS open_ended, count(*) AS versions, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, min(valid_from) AS min_from, max(valid_from) AS max_from
FROM dim_member
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

WITH cur AS (SELECT member_id, count(*) n_cur, count(DISTINCT tier) n_tier FROM dim_member WHERE is_current GROUP BY 1),
open_v AS (SELECT member_id, count(*) n_open FROM dim_member WHERE valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31' GROUP BY 1),
ranges AS (SELECT member_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-08' AND valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-08') n_on_date FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM cur WHERE n_cur>1) multi_current,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM open_v WHERE n_open>1) multi_open,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM ranges WHERE n_on_date<>1) bad_on_date,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member) total_members,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND valid_to <> DATE '9999-12-31') cur_not_open,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE NOT is_current AND valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31') open_not_cur,
 (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) max_sale,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE valid_from > DATE '2026-10-08') future_versions,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE member_id IS NULL) null_ids
